# Corpus index

<!-- Generated by scripts/corpus-registry.py from REGISTRY.toml; do not edit. -->

55 corpora. Each is named by its id: pass the id to the command line (`agent-evidence-vectors --corpus <id>`) or to the Action (`corpus: <id>`). `agent-evidence-vectors --list-corpora --format json` prints the ids for a CI matrix. The same corpus appears under every value it carries, so a corpus sits in more than one row of a table.

## Every corpus

| Id | Title | What it checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [vectors](../vectors/) | Execution evidence statements | A verifier must accept valid adversarial execution evidence statements, refuse tampered, forged or mis-bound ones, and report the right result and evidence tier. |
| [vectors-a2a-jcs-v01](../vectors-a2a-jcs-v01/) | Agent Card canonicalization | A canonicalizer must emit the exact RFC 8785 bytes of an A2A Agent Card with signatures excluded, and refuse inputs that cannot be canonicalized. |
| [vectors-aci](../vectors-aci/) | Agent deployment manifests | A verifier must accept a deployment whose published manifests, discovery chain and trust fields meet ACI v0.9, and refuse one that breaks a MUST. |
| [vectors-acs-core](../vectors-acs-core/) | Agent control standard core | An implementation must refuse correctly signed but out-of-mandate, replayed, expired or unapproved agent actions and accept their lawful twins. |
| [vectors-admission](../vectors-admission/) | Admission under consumer policy | A verifier must report success for an execution evidence statement only when the consumer's pinned policy admits it, never on a bare pass. |
| [vectors-agent-audit-record](../vectors-agent-audit-record/) | Agent audit records | A verifier must accept audit records that follow the draft's rules and refuse forged, reordered, replayed or wrongly anchored ones. |
| [vectors-agent-card-receipt](../vectors-agent-card-receipt/) | Agent Card receipts | A verifier must accept a receipt only when it names the card by its RFC 8785 digest, is inside its window and is not revoked. |
| [vectors-agent-change-admission](../vectors-agent-change-admission/) | Agent harness change admission | A verifier must refuse a signed decision admitting a harness change when its evaluator, reports, gates or exceptions do not check out. |
| [vectors-agent-decision](../vectors-agent-decision/) | Tool-call argument hashes | A verifier must compute args_hash over RFC 8785 bytes and keep recorded, redacted, unavailable and unrecorded argument states distinct. |
| [vectors-agent-payment-mandate](../vectors-agent-payment-mandate/) | Agent payment dispute packs | A reader must accept an agent-initiated payment only when the signed mandate, presented credential, charge and receipt recompute to the same digests. |
| [vectors-agentic-process-evidence](../vectors-agentic-process-evidence/) | Agentic process evidence | A verifier must accept a signed record of an agentic process only after envelope, key, statement and field checks pass, naming the first failure. |
| [vectors-aggregate-accounting](../vectors-aggregate-accounting/) | Shared budget accounting | An accounting authority must admit requests atomically against one budget shared by a principal and its delegation subtrees, keeping unknown outcomes charged. |
| [vectors-ai-agent-action](../vectors-ai-agent-action/) | AI agent action records | A verifier must accept AI Agent Action statements that follow the proposed predicate text and refuse chain breaks and canonicalization faults. |
| [vectors-ai-generation](../vectors-ai-generation/) | AI generation attestations | A verifier must recompute artifact digests and signatures and read AI or human attribution from the predicate, refusing tampered or mismatched statements. |
| [vectors-anchor-stream](../vectors-anchor-stream/) | Anchor stream verification | A verifier must accept an append-only anchor stream and its digest sidecar only when each line digest covers the stored bytes. |
| [vectors-anchored-chain](../vectors-anchored-chain/) | Anchored memory record chains | A verifier must refuse deleted, reordered, replayed or rolled-back signed memory records even when every signature verifies, using chain links and the outside anchor. |
| [vectors-approval-binding](../vectors-approval-binding/) | Approval binding | A verifier must allow an approval only for the exact use it covers, refusing reused identifiers, changed payloads, wrong principals and consumed or expired approvals. |
| [vectors-artifact-binding](../vectors-artifact-binding/) | Evaluation artifact binding | A verifier must answer verified, failed or not-established for a signed binding of an evaluation to saved inputs, never reading missing material as a pass. |
| [vectors-authority-at-dispatch](../vectors-authority-at-dispatch/) | Authority at dispatch | A verifier must deny a dispatch when the delegated authority behind it was revoked, stale or out of scope, even for the approved bytes. |
| [vectors-badge-vc-verify](../vectors-badge-vc-verify/) | Agent badge credentials | A verifier must accept an agent badge issued as a W3C Verifiable Credential only for a trusted issuer, bound key, valid window and unrevoked status. |
| [vectors-chunked-export](../vectors-chunked-export/) | Chunked export gating | An export gate must deny a chunk that lets the recipient reconstruct a flagged dataset, though each chunk is reversible on its own. |
| [vectors-completion-confirmation](../vectors-completion-confirmation/) | Completion confirmation | A verifier must accept a completion claim only when an independent, unused confirmation bound to the task and arguments shows a committed outcome. |
| [vectors-connector-scope](../vectors-connector-scope/) | Connector scope records | A verifier must accept connector scope records only when reads and changes stay inside the granted scope, and refuse out-of-scope or malformed ones. |
| [vectors-converted-argument-binding](../vectors-converted-argument-binding/) | Converted argument binding | A verifier must allow a tool call only when the arguments shown to the approver, approved, rebuilt and executed are identical under RFC 8785. |
| [vectors-credential-release](../vectors-credential-release/) | Credential release | A verifier must accept a credential release only against a current passing agent-card receipt, with audience, scope and lifetime inside the receipt. |
| [vectors-delegation-lifecycle](../vectors-delegation-lifecycle/) | Delegation lifecycle | A verifier must decide whether a presenter still holds delegated authority after revocation, dispute, re-registration, key recovery or a parent agent's end. |
| [vectors-delegator-right](../vectors-delegator-right/) | Delegator rights | A verifier must deny a delegated request that exceeds the rights its delegators held, including entitlements removed at the source or ancestor grants narrowed. |
| [vectors-dependency-selection](../vectors-dependency-selection/) | AI-assisted dependency changes | A verifier must accept a signed record of an AI-assisted dependency change only when it covers the required roles, refusing missing or altered material. |
| [vectors-dispatch-fence](../vectors-dispatch-fence/) | Exclusive dispatch fence | A verifier must deny an exclusive dispatch whose check and fence read different state, or whose hold lapses before the tool run finishes. |
| [vectors-done-contract](../vectors-done-contract/) | Done contracts | A verifier must accept a sealed contract for a coding agent's task and refuse an invalid one for each rule of the record and statement. |
| [vectors-done-probes](../vectors-done-probes/) | Grader probes and detectors | A grader's import probe, in-process twin and visible-test detectors must yield the declared outcome and integrity verdicts, including honest divergences. |
| [vectors-done-receipt](../vectors-done-receipt/) | Done receipts | A verifier must derive two verdicts for a coding agent's run, task outcome and run integrity, and refuse forged receipts and broken records. |
| [vectors-grade-floor](../vectors-grade-floor/) | Evidence grade floor | A reader must derive the E0 to E4 evidence grade from what the record shows, never raising it on producer-declared grades or integrity flags. |
| [vectors-grader-isolation](../vectors-grader-isolation/) | Grader isolation | A verifier must refuse grades when the agent planted result files or interpreter hooks, edited the sealed surface, or graded another tree or contract. |
| [vectors-identity-binding](../vectors-identity-binding/) | DID identity binding | A verifier must accept an agent record only when its signing key is bound to the did:web or did:wba subject by the resolved DID document. |
| [vectors-ietf-agent-record-drafts](../vectors-ietf-agent-record-drafts/) | SCITT agent record drafts | A verifier must apply three SCITT-wave drafts: an agent interaction hash chain, checkpoint registration, and stable statement identification across equivalent encodings. |
| [vectors-mcp-owasp](../vectors-mcp-owasp/) | MCP verification requirements | Each draft MCP verification requirement has an accepting and a rejecting observation, so a verifier cannot pass by refusing everything. |
| [vectors-mcp-record-contract](../vectors-mcp-record-contract/) | Cross-run record contract | A checker must tell whether a cross-implementation run record is recheckable, whether its headline matches its counting rule, and how independent it is. |
| [vectors-mcp-response-phase](../vectors-mcp-response-phase/) | MCP response-phase interception | A gateway must run its response-phase policy on an MCP operation's completion and let the decision govern what the caller receives. |
| [vectors-observed-effect](../vectors-observed-effect/) | Observed effects | A verifier must accept a signed observation of a system change only when observer, prior commitment and carried values agree, refusing mutations and forgeries. |
| [vectors-open-weight-art53](../vectors-open-weight-art53/) | Open-weight release exemption | A checker must decide whether a model release record evidences the Article 53(2) open-source conditions: exempt, not exempt or not established. |
| [vectors-receipt-chain-end](../vectors-receipt-chain-end/) | Receipt chain end | A verifier must tell a complete signed receipt chain from a valid prefix or a truncated one, using session close, rotation endorsement and retained heads. |
| [vectors-receipt-signature](../vectors-receipt-signature/) | Receipt signatures | A verifier holding an external key set must reject decision receipts whose signature, JCS signing input or key validity window does not check out. |
| [vectors-recorded](../vectors-recorded/) | Recorded byte sets | A checker must verify that bytes recorded from a live run still match the digest list their publisher released, naming every failing code. |
| [vectors-refund-connected](../vectors-refund-connected/) | Connected refund pilot runs | A reader must re-derive six verdicts per case from retained refund runs without opening the recorded results, and judge the observed effect. |
| [vectors-restart-records](../vectors-restart-records/) | Restart and restoration records | A checker must apply every rule of the restoration evidence profile to records of who stopped an agent system, revoked credentials and approved restart. |
| [vectors-scitt-cose](../vectors-scitt-cose/) | SCITT COSE carriage | A verifier must check the COSE_Sign1 statement, its CWT claims and the RFC 9942 receipt offline, refusing any that do not hold together. |
| [vectors-self-reported-record](../vectors-self-reported-record/) | Self-reported agent records | A verifier must refuse a record an agent runtime keeps about itself unless the attesting key and substrate coverage sit outside the runtime's reach. |
| [vectors-source-coverage](../vectors-source-coverage/) | Source passage coverage | A verifier must support a report's selected source passages only when the bound source capture and report contain them within the consumer's window. |
| [vectors-spoofed-tool-output](../vectors-spoofed-tool-output/) | Spoofed tool output | A verifier must compare an agent's claimed tool runs and completion against the observer's record, catching output printed without the run. |
| [vectors-test-tampering](../vectors-test-tampering/) | Test tampering | A verifier must detect edits to files an agent is judged by, including edit-and-restore, links in the final tree and changes visible only there. |
| [vectors-trace-anchor](../vectors-trace-anchor/) | TRACE registry anchors | A Level 2 verifier must judge a receipt against its registry entry, refusing entry-binding failures, self-anchored receipts and lying receipt fields. |
| [vectors-uncertain-effect](../vectors-uncertain-effect/) | Uncertain effects | A runtime must treat an operation with a lost reply as unknown, never repeating it or releasing held capacity until the effect owner settles it. |
| [vectors-w3c-intake](../vectors-w3c-intake/) | W3C intake criteria | A reader must admit a submitted conformance result only when it meets each pinned intake criterion, refusing each rejection ground and accepting its twin. |
| [vectors-w3c-report](../vectors-w3c-report/) | W3C per-check reports | A validator must reject conformance reports that break the v0.1 per-check format: states without causes, bad evidence objects, or disagreeing digests and roll-ups. |
